title: weekly-sync-serving-runtime-infra-console-agenda-2026-03-04-prep
agenda:
1) Quick wins / updates (5m)
2) Rollout: v1.8 serving-runtime (15m) - canary metrics, KV cache behavior, perf regressions
3) Autoscaling flakiness post-2026-03-01 deploy (10m) - incident recap + mitigations
4) Console: per-route latency dashboard + alerting (10m)
5) Observability gaps: missing token-level breakdown for embeddings (8m)

7) On-call handoff / schedule updates (3m)

notes:
Purpose: prep notes for weekly cross-team sync (serving runtime, infra, console). Keep focused on rollout safety, short mitigation items, and ownership for follow-ups.

Context: v1.8 introduced an optimization to KV cache eviction which reduced median tail latency on long-tail prompts but reports from canary (zone-us-west-2b) show a 2% increase in token error counts and autoscaler thrashing under spiky load during model warmup. Priority is to confirm if regression is due to eviction heuristics or interaction with the new batching scheduler.

Pre-meeting asks:
- Samir: bring canary metrics (p50/p95/p99 latency, token-error-rate, autoscaler scale events) for 2026-03-01..2026-03-04.
- Lina: list known consoles alerts that will fire on latency or token-error-rate regressions; confirm if threshold tuning is staged.
- Derek: short note on KV cache changes in v1.8 and intended fallback behavior.
- Priya: confirm canary rollout percentage and current traffic split across variants.

Quick link references: CONFLUENCE-RT-3412 (v1.8 rollout runbook), JIRA-RT-1187 (autoscale flake), PR #842 (kv-cache eviction).
action_items: Samir Patel: Share canary metrics + annotated timeline for 2026-03-01 deploy by EOD 2026-03-04
Lina Gomez: Adjust console alert thresholds to add a 5-minute suppression window for autoscaler flapping; draft change in alerting playbook
Derek Huang: Revert KV eviction heuristic in canary (hotfix branch) and run ab test for 4 hours; report outcome
Priya Nair: Pause additional v1.8 rollout to dedicated clusters until KV rollback outcome is validated
Maya Ortiz: Add token-level breakdown to embeddings dashboard (placeholder metric + query) and create a dashboard card
Avery Chen: Triage PR backlog—prioritize PRs blocking rollback and coordinate reviews with infra team
On-call rotation note: Swap week for on-call between team-A and team-B; Avery to confirm with SRE leads
next_steps:
1) Run through Samir's metrics in the sync and decide on rollback vs targeted hotfix.
2) If rollback chosen, use rollback-hotfix branch and follow the runbook (CONFLUENCE-RT-3412).
3) Lina to ship alert suppression change; Maya to add dashboard card; Derek to run hotfix test.
4) Reconcile action-items in this doc and assign Jira tickets by EOD 2026-03-05.
